# Apollo II v1.0.0 Beta — Cyberpunk Music Command System

Offline local music player with Android Auto media support and immersive audio-reactive visualizers.

## Highlights
- Media3 playback, playlists, Car Favorites, M3U
- Android Auto media browsing (owner-confirmed discoverable)
- Visualizer gallery including repaired **ST01** / **ST03**, MILK//LAB, Tron, Trance Reactor
- Album-art cache collision fixed

## Requirements
- Android 8.0+ (API 26)
- Personal/Owner profile for Android Auto

## Known limitations
- ECHOHUNT identification is scaffolding only
- ST01/ST03 device soak / screenshot pack still owner-validated
- Not Google Play / AA production-certified
- XorDev MilkDrop presets are not bundled
